author: sjm41
body:
* **InterPro ID / label**
IPR004313 Acireductone dioxygenase ARD family


* **Description of issue**
From the text description and the linked ECs, I think this entry should be annotated with both these GO terms:

GO:0010308 | acireductone dioxygenase (Ni2+-requiring) activity
GO:0010309 | acireductone dioxygenase [iron(II)-requiring] activity

(Currently it's only annotated with GO:0010309)

What do you think?
title: IPR004313 Acireductone dioxygenase ARD family

author: tony787
body:
Agree. There is a structure of Mouse Acireductone dioxygenase with Ni2+ ion and pentanoic acid in the active site (pdb:5I8S). I have added the term to the entry. Changes will appear in the next InterPro release.
Best wishes,
Toni

author: tony787
body: PS. It seems that Fe(2+)-bound protein catalyses on-pathway chemistry, whereas the Ni(2+) exhibits off-pathway chemistry. Thermal stability is affected by the metal ion identity.
